romsFolder.title: Choose where to create your roms folder

emulationFolder.title: Choose where to create your Emulation folder

esde.notFound: No ES-DE installation found (set the ES-DE folder in Settings → Library).

launch.recompNeedsFiles: Pick its game files on the Recompilation page first.
launch.recompChooseExe: Choose the program that starts it under Program on the Recompilation page.
launch.recompSaveConflict: Its saves changed on this PC and in the Emulation folder: pick which to keep on the Recompilation page.
launch.recompImageInRecycleBin: Its disc image is in the Recycle Bin: install the recompilation again, or restore the image and rescan.
launch.recompReinstall: Install the recompilation again from its Recompilation page.
launch.recompReinstallOrRestore: Install the recompilation again, or put the game file back and rescan.

imageUnreadable: The image could not be read.

update.closeGame: Close the running game before installing the update.
